2,767 likes, 165 comments - kaisafit on August 3, 2026: "Fun fact: I hate training alone and have never been able to stick to a workout routine that I’m supposed to do on my own.

Another fun fact: I’ve been a trainer for over 15 years and run a fitness company.

Last fun fact: staying consistent with your movement routine means finding something that you actually enjoy doing. Not forcing yourself to do what “fitness people do.” Because most of what you see is smoke and mirrors, just being honest 😁".
